data.why: The repository ships two real Varioskan kinetic workbooks (Rep1/Rep2) in examples/ that the app's own README names as the intended upload; a browser agent needs them as local files to pick in the uploader.

goals: Import a Varioskan OD/luminescence workbook and inspect the raw unaveraged long table and curves
Confirm detected strains, media/groups and experimental design before analysis
Flag and exclude bad wells or curves during QC review
Run guided blank correction, cross-talk deconvolution and OD normalization with one button
Extract kinetic metrics (peak, peak time, AUC, doubling time) and download the resulting CSV
Export and reload the full analysis state as a portable .luxplate project file

review.summary: This is a faithful, well-evidenced tree of the guided LuxPlate workflow: every screen I sampled shows what its node says, and the labels are mostly well split into general and specific. Before filing it needs the exclusion phase moved before processing, plus the metric-comparison figure gallery added as a task and a feature.
